Subject: Mic placement and backline ops for Aug 31 exec workshop

Hi team,

We have the executive workshop at BlueMeeting on Aug 31 (09:00–16:00). I need to lock the A/V plan today so we can circulate to BigCo and our internal ops. Key asks: 

- Recommended mic types and placement for a hybrid format with ~40 in-room (boardroom-style) + 30 remote joining via Zoom. We need low-profile micing for execs (no boom arms ideally).
- Wireless LAV count: we expect 6 presenters and 2 roaming moderators. Any channel contention concerns?
- Backup conferencing/bridge failover: what’s your plan if the primary Zoom bridge drops? Can you provide a local USB fallback into a redundant laptop + an RTP encoder for direct SIP fallback?
- House mix & record: will you supply a FOH console with two engineers (mix + stream)? Recommend staffing and earliest load-in window.
- Cable routing & stage footprint: I need a marked floorplan showing mic drops, snake location, and power requirements.

Julie (BigCo) — want to flag that BigCo product will demo live and there may be quick switching between presenters. Please call out any vendor constraints.

Please reply with a short bulleted plan and attach any quote/crew roster. We’re tight on budget but can prioritize redundancy for the keynote and product demo.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference

415-555-0133

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks — we can cover this. High-level proposal below (short version):

- Micing: 6 wireless LAVs (Sennheiser ew IEM/LAV) for presenters, 2 handhelds for Q&A. Low-profile boundary mics at the head table for redundancy (x3). We recommend LAVs on presenters and boundaries as passive backups.
- Mix & crew: FOH digital desk (32ch) + 2 engineers (FOH + stream engineer). Onsite tech lead + 1 rover for mic swaps; total crew 3.
- Bridge failover: primary Zoom via house network + encoded backup to a redundant laptop on separate ISP. We can supply an RTP/RTMP encoder appliance that can publish to a secondary endpoint (customer-provided SIP if required). We will also provide a USB audio bridge ready to plug into the laptop for immediate manual failover.
- Power & routing: dedicated 20A for sound rack, stage snake to stage left (see attached proposal). We’ll mark cable ramps for attendee flow.
- Load-in: earliest available is 06:00 on Aug 31 for full system; standard check at 07:15, mic check by 08:00. We recommend 30–45 minutes of dedicated rehearsal for the product demo.

Attached: SW-quote-0826.pdf (includes line items and provisional crew roster).

Open questions for Redwood/BigCo:
1) Confirm presenter list and clip-on preference (magnetic vs. clip).
2) Do you want a dedicated wireless IEM for the moderator?

Can send a marked-up floorplan by end of day when you confirm the presenter count.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Operations Lead

(415) 555-2099
